function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

There's no function for roster. We need to answer with a list. We can provide a list of current players. But we need to be careful: The roster changes. We can provide a general list. But maybe we can use the function to get top scorer? But the question is about roster. There's no function. So we should answer with a list. We can provide a list of players as of the latest season.
